title: Embedded, Real-Time, and Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems
purpose: Turn software timing, peripheral behavior, data movement, and fault handling into measurable physical-system behavior.
progression_rule: Complete modules in order until the first six are complete; later modules may be selected when their prerequisites are met.
